title: Witness sketch of cigar-shaped craft with windows on Henry Grady Hotel letterhead
description: Photographic reproduction, shown sideways, of a hand sketch on "HENRY GRADY HOTEL" Atlanta stationery depicting a long segmented cigar-shaped craft with a row of small windows, streamers trailing from one end and a pointed opposite end. Handwritten annotations include an estimated length of "100' in length", a small separate sketch labelled as crew position at upper left, and notes in the lower half. Photo number "A-34919 A.C." appears at upper right.
